summary.en: An Act to declare the limits of the territorial waters of Brunei

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-138-TERRITORIAL-WATERS-OF-BRUNEI-ACT.pdf》（5 页），本次切分 4 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Act may be cited as the Territorial Waters of Brunei Darussalam Act.

(1) It is hereby declared that the breadth of the territorial waters of Brunei Darussalam shall be 12 nautical miles.

(2) Such breadth shall be measured in accordance with international law. Publication of map

(1) So soon as may be possible or thereafter from time to time as he may consider necessary, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan shall cause to be published a large scale map indicating the low water marks, the baselines, the outer limits and the areas of the territorial waters of Brunei

(2) A copy of such map shall be published in the Gazette for general information.

(1) In any proceedings before any court in Brunei Darussalam, if question arises as to whether an act or omission has taken place within or outside the territorial waters of Brunei Darussalam, a certificate of that effect purported to be signed by or on behalf of the Minister shall be received in evidence and shall be prima facie proof of the facts stated therein.

(2) Any reference to the territorial waters of Brunei Darussalam in any written law shall be construed subject to the provisions of this Act.
